name: ai.privos.mcp-app-hr-and-hrm
title: HR & HRM
description: HR management app for PrivOS: recruitment boards, CV screening pipeline, employee lifecycle profiles, payroll, document drafting and room email history.

permissions.reason: Identify the approved installation and room so the dashboard can load safely.
Read the recruitment, CV pipeline, employee profile and email-history lists of this room.
Create and update recruitment boards, CV items, employee profiles and email-history records.
Read CVs, job descriptions, skill files and generated documents stored in the room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Document previews, CV screening and template loading are unavailable.

permissions.reason: Upload CVs, job descriptions, skill files, email templates and generated DOCX exports to the room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Uploads and document generation are disabled; existing records are unchanged.

permissions.reason: Read the AI chat history the CV screening, JD editing and drafting assistants produce in this room.
Send prompts to the room assistant for CV screening, JD editing and document drafting.
Start and poll the room sandbox generation that answers each assistant prompt.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The assistant tabs cannot produce new answers.

permissions.reason: Read this app's own room-scoped payroll records through its installation-bot credential.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The Payroll tab cannot load payroll records.

permissions.reason: Create, update and delete payroll records in this app's own room-scoped App Database collection.
Read the payroll collection's registered schema before reading or writing records.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The Payroll tab cannot verify its collection schema.

permissions.reason: Register the payroll collection schema (privos.db.registerCollection) once per room.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The Payroll tab cannot initialise its collection.

dataPolicy.retention: App data is retained until the installation or corresponding HR records are deleted.
